highlights: View Mermaid diagrams at their original size, set a default scale, zoom each diagram separately, and keep multiple diagram windows open while reading Markdown.
Open FTP, FTPS, and SFTP profiles through NetBox and configure per-profile starting folders, navigation caches, and connection timeouts.
Use explicit or implicit FTPS and choose active or passive data connections, keepalive, and listing compatibility settings.
Move remote items to a server-side recycle bin and keep previous versions of overwritten SFTP files.
Customize remote filename encoding, line endings, and timestamp handling for directory listings and downloads.
